user.title: Choose target calendar type
user.description: Calendar Mirror can sync into Google Calendar or into a generic CalDAV server (e.g. Nextcloud, mailbox.org, Radicale).

caldav_credentials.title: Connect to your CalDAV server
caldav_credentials.description: Enter your CalDAV server's connection details. The connection is tested before continuing.

source_calendars.title: Choose source calendars
source_calendars.description: Select the Home Assistant calendar entities to mirror into the target calendar.

target_calendar.title: Choose target calendar
target_calendar.description: Pick which of your Google Calendars to sync events into. If your calendars couldn't be loaded, enter a calendar ID manually instead (use "primary" for your main calendar, or the calendar's address from Google Calendar settings).

caldav_target_calendar.title: Choose target calendar
caldav_target_calendar.description: Pick which of your CalDAV calendars to sync events into. If your calendars couldn't be loaded, enter a calendar's URL manually instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Calendar Mirror
reauth_confirm.description: Your Google authorization has expired or been revoked. Sign in again to keep syncing.

caldav_reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Calendar Mirror
caldav_reauth_confirm.description: Your CalDAV password for {caldav_username} no longer works. Enter the current password to keep syncing.

error.no_calendars_selected: Select at least one source calendar.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the CalDAV server. Check the URL and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the CalDAV server.

abort.already_configured: This calendar is already being synced by another Calendar Mirror entry.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, check the help section.
abort.missing_credentials: The integration requires credentials to be set up before it can be used. Add the credentials, then try again.

init.title: Reconfigure Calendar Mirror
init.description: Change which Home Assistant calendars are mirrored and which calendar they sync into.

error.no_calendars_selected: Select at least one source calendar.
error.target_already_configured: Another Calendar Mirror entry is already syncing into this calendar.

application_credentials.description:
Follow the [instructions]({more_info_url}) for setting up a Google API OAuth client. You will need to create credentials with a **Web application** type authorized to redirect to {redirect_uri}.

To be able to configure Calendar Mirror you first need to set up access to the [Google Cloud Console]({oauth_creds_url}) and enable the Calendar API on the [consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}).
